'''''AAA Tow''''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] that was picking up and delivering supplies to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] during his attempt to defect to the Alliance.
